patthana21.52:1.1: na sārammaṇaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anārammaṇo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana21.52:2.1: na anārammaṇaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anārammaṇo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ. gaṇitakena tīṇi.
patthana21.52:4.1: na sārammaṇaṃ na anidassanaappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anārammaṇo anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ. nocittaduka nasanidassanattike cittaduka sanidassanattikaṃ no cittaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ. na
patthana21.52:5.1: nocittaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana21.52:6.1: gaṇitakena tīṇi. nacetasikaduka nasanidassanattike cetasikaduka sanidassanattikaṃ na cetasikaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cetasiko sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.52:10.1: na cittasampayuttaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittavippayutto sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.52:11.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nacittasaṃsaṭṭhaduka nasanidassanattike cittasaṃsaṭṭhaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.52:12.1: na cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasaṃsaṭṭho sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.52:13.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nocittasamuṭṭhānaduka nasanidassanattike cittasamuṭṭhānaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.52:14.1: no cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. cittasamuṭṭhānarūpeneva tīṇi.
patthana21.52:16.1: no cittasahabhuṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasahabhū sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.52:17.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nocittānuparivattiduka nasanidassanattike cittānuparivattiduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.52:18.1: no cittānuparivattiṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittānuparivattī sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.52:19.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaduka nasanidassanattike cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.52:20.1: no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.52:21.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nacittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuduka nasanidassanattike cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.52:22.1: no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhū sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.52:23.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nacittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiduka nasanidassanattike cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.52:24.1: no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattī sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.52:25.1: hetuyā tīṇi. naajjhattikaduka nasanidassanattike ajjhattikaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.52:26.1: na ajjhattikaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana21.52:27.1: na bāhiraṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ. gaṇitakena
patthana21.52:28.1: tīṇi. naupādāduka nasanidassanattike upādāduka sanidassanattikaṃ na
patthana21.52:29.1: upādā na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upādā sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.52:30.1: hetuyā ekaṃ. naupādinnaduka nasanidassanattike upādinnaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
patthana21.52:31.1: na upādinnaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anupādinno sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.52:32.1: hetuyā tīṇi. noupādānagocchakaduka nasanidassanattike upādānagocchakaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
